description: On the table there are colorful plastic utensils and plates in a small pile, a yellow bottle to the right, and a blue sponge cloth near the center. The right hand grips the sponge cloth and rubs it around a red utensil in the left hand, then sets the sponge on the utensil pile, picks up a blue fork and wipes along its handle and tines while the left hand steadies nearby red utensils.
